tour.interactiveHint: You can use the highlighted area now.
tour.step1.body: Inventory shows your tradable items and current warframe.market prices. Click a card to view orders or list the item.
tour.step10.body: Relics can show your collection or the full catalog. Search by reward, find relics with unowned items, and compare expected value.
tour.step11.body: View and manage your warframe.market orders here. Completed trades can close matching orders automatically.
tour.step12.body: Browse shows public buy and sell orders without signing in. You can copy a whisper or create your own order.
tour.step13.body: Use these tabs for unveiled Rivens, veiled Rivens, and Riven Finder. Click an owned Riven to see its grades. Riven Finder searches market listings by weapon and stats.
tour.step14.body: Arbitration runs are recorded automatically. Open a run for details or import an EE.log file.
tour.step15.body: Search for an item to see where it drops.
tour.step16.body: Configure the relic, Riven, trade, and arbitration overlays here.
tour.step17.body: Choose which tabs and notifications you want. You can restart this tour here.
tour.step2.body: Use these tabs to switch item types. Full Sets shows every set you can sell as a complete set.
tour.step3.body: Foundry shows builds you can start, builds in progress, and items ready to claim. Pinned recipes stay at the top.
tour.step4.body: Mastery tracks your rank progress and the items you have not mastered.
tour.step5.body: Press Ctrl+F to search. Filters can be combined. Use the arrow next to Sort to change direction.
tour.step6.body: MR Roadmap suggests what to master next. Easy uses owned and Foundry items. From Relics uses your relics. With Platinum compares XP per platinum.
tour.step7.body: Stats tracks resources and trades detected in EE.log. You can also import AlecaFrame history.
tour.step8.body: World shows cycles, fissures, invasions, bounties, and Circuit rotations. Cycle alerts are optional.
tour.step9.body: Filter the arbitration schedule by node or save a preset. Click a bell to get a notification before that arbitration starts.
